title: Violation baselines
description: Per-rule, per-file violation counts during cleanup. Counts for checks with no native baseline, plus a summary of every rule for the dashboard. Doc 09.

native.description: Path of the linter's own baseline file, when the rule has one. That file is the baseline; this entry is a mirror for the dashboard.

by_file.description: Per-file counts. The ratchet is per file so a fix in one place cannot pay for a new violation in another.
